name: Agro Tech Foods Limited
summary: Operating both domestically in India and on a global scale, Agro Tech Foods Limited is involved in the production, distribution, sale, and commercial exchange of food items and cooking oils, marketed primarily under the Sundrop and ACT II brands. Established in 1986, the firm's headquarters are situated in Gurugram, India, and it functions as a subsidiary of CAG-Tech (Mauritius) Limited.
